camera.shot_scale_bias: tight framing with the subject pressed to one edge

lens.dof: very shallow focus, with foreground objects blurring across the lens

lighting.practicals: coloured practicals sit in frame and smear when the camera moves

composition.movement_of_subject: figures pass through the frame while the camera stays on what they left behind

sound.ambience_bias: close interior hum, rain on awnings, distant street traffic

music.instrumentation: A looping lounge waltz on strings and vibraphone
music.dynamics: repeating without resolving, dropping out abruptly at the cut

must_include: the subject is partly hidden behind a doorway, a pillar or a passing body
coloured light falls across the face in bands

notes: Long lens, cramped interiors, saturated practical colour. The camera watches from behind something rather than facing the subject squarely.
